node: HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers one or two layers below memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HBM/advanced-packaging sub-supplier node with a two-lane lens. The reference context remains HBM producers, foundries, OSATs and AI accelerator customers, but the discovery lane is more attractive in mid-cap equipment, probe-card, inspection/metrology, bonding and test-contacting suppliers. Four names survive this Layer 1B pass: Camtek, FormFactor, Kulicke & Soffa and Cohu. All are US-listed and plausibly tied to the bottleneck layer, but evidence quality differs: CAMT, FORM and COHU have direct HBM-related disclosures; KLIC is included as an advanced-packaging bonding-tool hypothesis that requires harder customer/qualification verification.
